entities.name: Courtly Love & Romance Ideal
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Troubadour poets in southern France invented "courtly love" (fin'amors) — the idea that love should be passion-driven, idealized, and devoted. Ironically, courtly love was almost always extramarital (marriages were political). Eleanor of Aquitaine's "courts of love" debated love's rules as legal cases.
